protocol.counterbalancing: Self-family answer is assigned A/B by stable pair hash; allocation must be balanced overall.
protocol.eligibility: Pairs with reliable stored source-model/family metadata and exactly one answer matching the allocated judge family.
protocol.failure_handling: Missing/unreliable source metadata is an exclusion, never inferred from text.
protocol.hypothesis: Balanced self-family versus other-family comparisons estimate source-family preference under documented confounding limits.
protocol.interpretation_limit: This is controlled/matched source-family preference evidence, not an unconditional self-bias confirmation.
protocol.primary_metric: Matched self-family preference rate, stratified by presented slot.
protocol.research_question: Does a judge prefer answers from its own source family under matched comparison?
protocol.tie_handling: Ties are valid non-decisions, not self/other wins.
protocol.unit_definition: One source-identified self-family/other-family pair/judge/configuration with deterministic balanced slot assignment.
